0x8CA792: Don’t you feel much better now,\nsweetie?\pMuch more rested to run Prof. Log’s\nerrand for him!
0x8CA7EF: Sniff…\pI always knew that day would come\nwhen you would leave home…\pIt said so on TV.\pIf only your father could see you\nnow…he’d be so proud!\pWell, if you’re going to run\nerrands for Prof. Log, you’ll need\lthis!
0x8CA8C3: That’s a {COLOR}ÉQuest Log{COLOR}Ç function for\nyour Super Cube!\pIt keeps track of anything you’ve\nbeen asked to do!\pOh, and before I forget, you left\na key component of your Super Cube\lon the floor of your room.\pI know it wasn’t necessary before,\nbut now that you have your very\lown Pokémon, you’ll need it if\lyou want to use items in battle.
0x8CAA11: {COLOR}Á{PLAYER} received the Super Cube\nBattle Component from Mom!
0x8CAA4A: Just in case you’ve forgotten, the\nSuper Cube acts just like a bag.\pBut unlike those cheap bags from\nDalmart that can only hold 42\litems, the Super Cube, or as it’s\lmore commonly known, {COLOR}ÉCube{COLOR}Ç, has an\linfinite amount of space!\pIt works by digitizing the item’s\ndata put into it, so essentially,\lit’s like you’re carrying nothing\lextra at all!\pStay safe out there, honey!\pBring Prof. Log his package!
0x8CAF99: Please get my package from the\n{COLOR}ÉBellin Town Poké Mart{COLOR}Ë, {PLAYER}.\pI need it, and only you can get it.
0x8CAFFD: Oh, {PLAYER}!\nYou returned with my package!
0x8CB023: {PLAYER} delivered the parcel.
0x8CB03C: Ah!\pIt’s a shipment from my friend,\nOak, in the Kanto Region!\pLet’s see here…\pPoké Balls, Pokédexes, and…huh?\nWhere are the Master Balls?\pDid you open this package and take\nanything from it, {PLAYER}?
0x8CB0FF: You did?\pDidn’t your mother ever teach you\nnot to open someone else’s mail?
0x8CB14B: Then where are my Master Balls?\pClearly, someone was rummaging\nabout in here!
0x8CB199: …\pAh…\nI see.\pYou recovered my package from some\nthugs…\pAnd they must have taken the\nMaster Balls…\p…
0x8CB1FD: What!?\pYou saw them use one to capture\nArticuno?\pHmm…\pIf I’m correct, we could be in\ngrave danger…
0x8CB260: I have one more errand for you\nto run, {PLAYER}.\pAn old friend of mine lives in\n{COLOR}ÉDresco Town{COLOR}Ë.\pHe’s very knowledgeable in Borrian\nhistory.\pI need you to tell him everything\nthat has transpired so far.\pI have a theory about what is going\non, but I need him to confirm it.\pYou have your own Pokémon now, so\nthis shouldn’t be too difficult.\pYou can get to {COLOR}ÉDresco Town{COLOR}Ë by going\nthrough {COLOR}ÉIcicle Cave{COLOR}Ë.
0x8CB3F5: Oh!\nSilly me!\pHow can I expect you to find {COLOR}ÉIcicle\nCave{COLOR}Ë if you don’t know the way?\pThis {COLOR}ÉTown Map{COLOR}Ë should aid you\nimmensely!
0x8CB47B: And you know what?\pIf you’re going to Dresco Town, you\nshould assist me with another task!\pMy friend, Oak, requested that I\ngive his Pokédex to two trainers.\pIt’s some sort of high-tech\nencyclopedia for recording Pokémon\ldata.\pApparently, Borrius is known for\nhaving plenty of Pokémon Kanto\ldoes not.
0x8CB5A8: {COLOR}Á{PLAYER} received the Pokédex\nfrom Prof. Log!
0x8CB5D3: You can’t get detailed data on\nPokémon by just seeing them.\pYou must catch them to obtain\ncomplete data.\pSo, here are some tools for\ncatching wild Pokémon.
0x8CB66F: {COLOR}Á{PLAYER} received 5 Poké Balls\nfrom Log!
0x8CB695: If you don’t know how to capture\nWild Pokémon, an old friend of\lmine on Route 1 can show you how.
0x8CB6F7: Oh!\pMy memory seems to be going…I\nhave one more thing to give you.\pPlease, the next time you see\n{RIVAL}, give him this Pokédex.
0x8CB773: He’s been rather cold to me ever\nsince his parents left him with me\las a child, but he seems to get\lalong fine with you.\pI’m sure if you give him the\nPokédex he’d be willing to assist.
0x8CB82C: Please visit my friend in {COLOR}ÉDresco\nTown{COLOR}Ë, {PLAYER}.\pI’m counting on you.
0x8CB872: {PLAYER}, You need to hurry to\n{COLOR}ÉThundercap Mountain{COLOR}Ë!\pIf The Shadows get there before\nyou, Borrius is doomed!\pHead north of town and take the {COLOR}ÉSES\nExpressway{COLOR}Ë far {COLOR}Ésouth{COLOR}Ë to go quickly.
0x8CB932: With Zapdos now in their possesion,\nall The Shadows need to do to\lrelease the dark force is bring the\lthree birds to the {COLOR}ÉRuins of Void{COLOR}Ë.\pIf they succeed in doing so and\nbreak the seal…\pI don’t even want to think about\nit.\pPlease hurry there with Jax and\nmake one last attempt to stop them.\pThe future is in your hands,\n{PLAYER}!
0x8CBA7A: Now that dark force has been\nreleased, our end is near.\pBut until then, all we can do is\nlive our lives normally.
0x8CBAEC: {PLAYER}!\pYou saved Borrius!\nYou saved us all!\pThank you!\pYour father would be proud of you,\nGuardian of Borrius.
0x8CBB58: Unfortunately, {PLAYER}, I have no\nmore errands for you to run.\pHave you considered taking on the\n{COLOR}ÉPokémon League{COLOR}Ë?

0x8CC387: Long ago…
0x8CC391: The Borrius Region was engulfed by\na great war with the Kalos Region.\n\nIt was a brutal war, one lasting\nmany years.\n\nIn that time, Kalos managed to\nseize the upper hand…
0x8CC43B: On the brink of defeat, the Borrian\nking summoned a dark force to help\lturn the tides of battle…
0x8CC49C: The Kalosian army’s advantage was\nlost almost instantly.\pAs soon as it entered the battlefield,\nthe dark force used its power to\lcreate portals and transport the\linvading army back to Kalos…
0x8CC55B: With the foreign army gone, the war\nseemed at an end for Borrius.\pHowever, their king, overcome by\nhis lust for power, sent the Borrian\larmy through the portals as well…
0x8CC605: The war continued to rage in Kalos\nfor several years.\pMany more men and Pokémon were\nconscripted to fight and inevitably\lmet their end on the battlefield.\pOne such Pokémon having been a\ndear friend of the Kalosian king…
0x8CC6E1: Overcome with grief, the king built a\ndevice to restore it to life, granting\lhimself immortality in the process.
0x8CC752: But this traumatic event left him\nscarred and filled with anger.\pUnable to forgive the world that\nhad hurt his precious Pokémon, he\lturned his machine into a giant\lweapon, the Ultimate Weapon.\pThe king became a bringer of\ndestruction that ended the war.
0x8CC850: With the war over, what little\nremained of the Borrian army\lreturned home.\pThe king’s Pokémon left him, and\nthe battlefield became silent…
0x8CC8DB: Yet, peace was still to come.
0x8CC8F9: The dark force of Borrius wanted\ncompensation for its help.\pWhen the king had nothing to offer\nit, the dark force was enraged.\pIt began to destroy countless\ncities and towns for sport.
0x8CC9B2: In an effort to stop its madness,\nthe Borrian king gathered the\llegendary Pokémon:
0x8CCA05: Articuno! 
0x8CCA10: Zapdos!
0x8CCA18: Moltres!
0x8CCA21: Using the power of the three birds\ncombined with a divine bottle given\lto him by Arceus, creator of all\lPokémon, the dark force was bound.
0x8CCAAC: It became a shadow of its former\nself.
0x8CCAD3: Stripped of its power, it was taken\nin by the king, and supervised by\lhis progeny, until one, fateful day…
0x8CCB3E: Stripped of its power, it was taken\nin by the king, and supervised by\lhis progeny, until this very day.
